What it would look like

Six screens from a first draft, built in your brand.

These are working sketches, not screenshots of a finished product. Project figures come from your website. People, names and amounts inside the screens are examples.

1 · Lead inbox

Every Meta lead, in seconds, to the right person.

  • Leads arrive straight from your Meta forms, with the ad, project, budget and language already filled in.
  • Assigned automatically by language: Russian to Alina, Armenian to Artak, Greek to Nicole, English to Joe.
  • One tap opens WhatsApp with a first message in the lead's own language.
  • Duplicates are merged, so the same person from two ads is one client.

A lead called in the first hour is far more likely to pick up than one called the next day. The inbox shows who is waiting.

4 · Live availability

Every unit of every Victoria, always up to date.

  • One board per project, block by block and floor by floor: available, reserved, sold.
  • Reserving a unit in the pipeline marks it here, so two salespeople never promise the same apartment.
  • The "Apts left" on your website can update itself from this board.

Click the projects. The totals are the real numbers from your website today.

5 · After the sale

Payment plans and buyer updates on autopilot.

  • Each buyer's payment plan, tied to the construction stages of their building.
  • Reminders before each instalment, to the buyer and to your accounts team.
  • Construction updates sent to buyers when a stage is done, using the drone and site videos we already film.

Happy buyers refer friends and buy again. Many of your clients are investors, and investors buy more than once.

6 · Ads to sales

Know which ad sells apartments, not only which ad gets forms.

  • Cost per enquiry, per meeting and per reservation, for every language, project and video.
  • The CRM tells Meta who actually became a meeting or a buyer. Meta then looks for more people like them.
  • A weekly summary to management by email, without anyone building a report.

Your Cyprus campaign is already set to "Maximise qualified leads", and Meta now asks for a CRM connection to grow it. This is that connection.

Why build it with us

We already know where every one of your leads comes from.

We run your ads

We built your forms in five languages and the routing that sorts the leads. The CRM plugs into what already works, with no new setup for your team.

Pheme runs every day on a CRM we built ourselves: clients, leads, delivery and reports. We are offering you what we use.

Shaped around how you sell

Projects, blocks, units, payment plans by construction stage. Generic CRMs think in "deals". Yours will think in apartments.

It grows with you

A new Victoria is a new board. A new idea from your team goes to us directly, not into a support ticket queue.
